description: This PHP source file is part of the vtiger CRM system. It handles settings for custom module entity numbering, including retrieving module information, validating inputs, and updating sequence numbers for modules through a web interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class used to render the HTML views for the settings pages.

methods.name: getCRMSupportedModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported CRM modules that are entity types with specific UI types and presence status.
